concepts.name: AlternateTwo-Plus
concepts.disposition: A projected lock-free TaskArena scheduler with channel and poller wake modes; no Go implementation exists in repository history.

concepts.name: AlternateTwo-Plus mini fast path
concepts.disposition: A documented interim single-mode fast-path proposal; no Go implementation exists in repository history.

concepts.name: AlternateThree with fast path
concepts.disposition: A channel fast-path proposal for the original Main snapshot; no Go implementation exists in repository history.

concepts.name: Main with optional TaskArena
concepts.disposition: The documented conservative optional-TaskArena proposal was not implemented.

concepts.name: Main with hybrid TaskArena fallback
concepts.disposition: The documented bounded-arena plus chunk-fallback proposal was not implemented.

concepts.name: Optimized Main without TaskArena
concepts.disposition: The documented minimal-change proposal combined partial chunk clearing, cache-line padding, and further wakeup deduplication without a TaskArena. No distinct Go implementation of that bundle exists in repository history; the later product removed the referenced chunked-ingress topology, so this proposal remains non-benchmarkable historical evidence.
